definitions.armor_absorbed_hit: PvP damaged signal fired while victim ultimate_armor_timer > 0; full damage but no knockback/hitstun/cancel
definitions.frey_spike: after an observed open window, timer changed open->closed while action_locked_until_land became true
definitions.heart_laser: heart_laser node became valid during that transformation
definitions.hit_within_1s: caster received PvP damage in [cast, cast+1.0s]
definitions.likely_cancelled: hit within 1s and the cast produced zero PvP ultimate-window hit events; inference, not a cancellation signal
